args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The trapping mechanism originates from the Lumen Concern striking “the Whole” while digging for lumen, which caused space to fold and time to catch [5]. This created a temporal loop lasting just under an hour that repeats endlessly [2]. Whenever the hour turns, the loop resets anyone inside who “can't feel it” (or “couldn't hold the deep Facets back”) to the threshold, wiping their memory of that iteration and forcing them to walk in again fresh [2], [3], [7]. Because of this reset, the earlier parties never escaped—they were trapped in an endless cycle of entering, experiencing the collapse, and being wiped clean, all while no time passes on the outside [2], [3].

Odeline Marran remembers every turn because she possesses the rare ability to perceive and “hold the deep Facets back,” which makes her immune to the loop’s memory wipe and positional reset [7]. Having been caught in the loop during her fourth survey, she has been living the same hour for nine years [6]. This prolonged exposure allows her to track the folding and unfolding of the space, enabling her to call out precise timings for navigation and ultimately coordinate an escape before the hour turns again [3], [7].
